Name: Lighter Lorenz - the Sebastian replacer mod
Author: AkurraV
Description:
[center]This mod will replace Sebastian, with the Undefeated Champion himself, Lighter Lorenz! All with personalized seasonal sprites and portraits, [b]even his bike[/b], and
a few other name changes in dialogues! Just download and you'd have him
straight in your game!


﻿[b]﻿Please read!

This mod [u]may not[/u] be compatible with other file changing mods like Stardew valley Expanded and Ridgeside Valley! [/b]If used together may cause the Lighter mod to not work properly.


[b]Lighter's portraits are upscaled[/b], so you'd need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod to make sure he shows up correctly.

To get his portraits working, all you need to do is find the folder labeled [b]"Akurra's Lighter Portraits"[/b] in the [b]Lighter mod folder[/b], then drag it to [b]Portraiture > Portraits.[/b] Place it inside the[b] "Portraits" [/b]folder and you should be good!

To make sure his portrait shows up, you'd need to speak with him. if it
still doesn't show up, please press "P" in your keyboard to switch
portrait packs, or "O" to fix potential problems. It should work after!
:)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u]Troubleshooting!
[/u][/b][b][u]
[/u][/b]To those[b] unable to fix his portraits even after pressing keys[/b], please try to delete the "Akurra's Lighter Portraits" folder ([b]make sure to have another copy somewhere[/b], maybe keep one in the Lighter Mod folder! It won't be read by the system so it won't break the game, dw!), and then [b]copy it back to "Portraiture" > "Portraits"[/b] like where it was before! It should be refreshed and hopefully works!

Don't hesitate to message me by Twitter/X dms or Instagram if you encounter more problems! :D (Links on the bottom of the page.)

[b][size=5]If there are problems, please refer to the FAQ [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rJxDRpNEtrXEjIrWXAhJjVoZkATLG6ii/view?usp=sharing]here[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Due to my limitations, I have yet to be able to make Lighter into a
standalone character himself, but I have been experimenting! I have a
custom Aventurine NPC mod in the works just like that, with his own
house, story and schedules, and hopefully he'll run around the game just
fine like everyone else! :D
(Though everything is practically ready, I'm having trouble modding his heart events.. I have ideas, but coding
it in is a little to much of a learning curve. if anyone could help with
it, I'd be honored! But overall, I'll be trying it out myself.)

So far [b]only portrait, sprite and name changes are made[/b], no edits on gift tastes or dialogue. I might do them when i rework him into a standalone character someday!
